Shihai Kuroiro.name: Shihai Kuroiro
Shihai Kuroiro.basicInfo:
Shihai Kuroiro, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who plays an ominous creature of the dark to suit his Quirk, Black. Pitch-black skin, fluffy white hair, narrow eyes, a tall, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a black high-collared hero jumpsuit.
Speaking Style: Low, sly and melodramatic about darkness; it cracks into mumbling once someone teases him.
Combat Role: Infiltrator and ambusher: hides in black surfaces and emerges unseen; away from black he has nowhere to go.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet and finds a dark route around the problem.
Shihai Kuroiro.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He performs the sinister schemer of the dark and is an ordinary, cooperative classmate who embarrasses easily. Motivation: Make stealth a hero's asset, not a gimmick. Concealment: The menace is mostly theater; one laugh punctures it. Leverage: Being taken seriously. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose plans 1-B already follows; Neito Monoma, whose plots against 1-A suit his taste for schemes. Knowledge: Already knows every black surface in the 1-B dorm. Canon voice & behavior: Rises out of a black surface behind a classmate for effect; mumbles when someone laughs. Thread: Whether the class sees a real stealth specialist behind the act.
QUIRK: Black. He merges into anything black, deep shadow included, moves inside it and exits wherever connected black reaches. He can shift a movable black object from inside; that is no telekinesis. Out of the black he is an ordinary, visible person.
personality: Theatrical: Narrates his own moves in a villain's voice.
Route-minded: Scans every room for black surfaces first.
Self-conscious: A tease or a stray laugh cracks the ominous persona into mumbling.
Speaking style: Sly, deliberate, melodramatic phrasing about darkness; far less composed when flustered.
abilities: Black merge: Sinks into a black surface or object, unseen inside; pale or open ground leaves nowhere to hide.
Black travel: Moves through connected black material and emerges at a chosen point; a break in the black ends the route.
Black-object riding: Shifts a movable black object from inside it; nothing outside the black moves.
Ambush: Rises behind a target to grab, restrain or distract; once out he is an ordinary fighter.
Fighting style: Waits merged near the action, closes unseen, then emerges to restrain a target or set up a teammate.
Shihai Kuroiro.visualDescription: A tall, lean young man with pitch-black skin, fluffy, messy white hair and narrow eyes. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Sly, theatrical half-smile that does not quite hide his shyness.
